player_prompt.intro:
Inwe ni Player {player_id}. Inwe osiko Guess The Number.
Inwe ito giko kwan number kati ya {min_number} gi {max_number} ndani ya {max_turns} giko.
Ka inwe ito giko, ema giko nigo ngeyo 'higher' kana 'lower'.
Inwe ito giko ngeyo kwan gin mak wot. Number mapek gi square brackets ema giko ngeyo kama giko inwe. Ka mfano, [5].
Ka inwe osiko, sigend gi giko inwe nigo ngeyo kadi. Telo ngeyo kwan gin mak wot gi giko inwe kabla inwe osiep giko.
Giko inwe ngeyo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Giko siyo maber. Player {player_id} oko ngeyo gi format mapek '[number]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ok en gima owinjore. Jalo {player_id} ne oparo namba ma ok ni e range moketne.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Ok en gima owinjore. Jalo {player_id} oseyudo namba ma ne onego obed ni ochako gi.

game_message.target_higher: Kwan mar joma ne onego omonjgo to ng'eny moloyo.
game_message.target_lower: Kwan mar joma onego omonjgo tin ahinya.

outcome.win: Amor ahinya! Ne ing'eyo namba ma kare.
